blocks.orig: The Mambo View Point Eco Lodge lies in the remote village of Mambo in the Usambara Mountains. Perched high on a mountain top, the lodge offers spacious double cottages, a honeymoon suite and a family cottage with lots of privacy, all boasting the most amazing view over the surrounding mountains and plains. The stone cottages are set up with traditional thatched roofs, ensuite bathrooms, simple but cosy wooden furniture, free but slow WiFi (as you are high on this remote mountain!) and large windows to fully take in the view. The house restaurant takes care of hungry stomachs after exhilarating hikes through the Usambara Mountains, with the possibility of hiking for several days before reaching Mambo View. Cultural visits to local tribes are recommended as well, as the Dutch owners of the lodge support a variety of community projects.
blocks.html: In the remote village of Mambo, in the Usambara Mountains, you find the Mambo View Point Eco Lodge. Set high on a mountain top, it has spacious double cottages, a honeymoon suite and a family cottage, all very private and all with a wonderful view across the mountains and plains around it. The stone cottages have traditional thatched roofs, ensuite bathrooms, simple yet cosy wooden furniture, free but slow WiFi (you are high up on a remote mountain, after all!) and big windows so you can take in the view. After an invigorating hike through the Usambara Mountains, the in-house restaurant looks after your appetite, and you can even hike for several days before you arrive at Mambo View. We also recommend cultural visits to local tribes, since the Dutch owners of the lodge support various community projects.
